newsitem.title: USA: Emerging Markets fund Q1 Aug reports loss.
newsitem.headline: Emerging Markets fund Q1 Aug reports loss.

text.p: Emerging Markets Telecommunications Fund Inc said on Monday that it had a net investment loss of $17,889 during the first quarter ended August 31, compared with a net investment income of $120,161 for the same period last year.
The fund, whose fiscal year ends May 31, 1997, said the loss was equal to less than $0.01 per share against an income equal to $0.01 per share last year.
Net realized and unrealized gains were $810,111, or $0.09 per share, for the same period compared with net realized and unrealized losses of $4.4 million, or $0.53 per share, it said.

The fund said total net assets were $177.4 million for the first quarter against $157.6 million for the same period last year. Emerging Markets invests mainly in stock in telecommunications companies in emerging countries.
